findings.comment: Sheet 3 (General Notes) does not include a note stating that the site lies within the Austin Energy service area. While Austin Energy notes are present on the sheet, no specific note confirming AE service area location was found.

Sheet 3 does not include the required developer responsibility note stating that the developer is responsible for designing and constructing all conduit and related infrastructure to current Austin Energy Electric Service Standards, including conductor installation costs, and for coordinating with other utilities to resolve conflicts. Only a note regarding relocation costs was found.

Sheet 21 shows a CAD file (SP-2025-0126C_SHEET_21_ELEC.dwg) but does not explicitly state the AutoCAD version (e.g., 2016 or newer). The version requirement per AEDC 1.16.0(1) cannot be verified from available drawings.

applicableAreas: Sheet 21 - Preliminary Electrical Design Plan; Site Plan
findings.comment: Plans do not demonstrate that the proposed development will not limit Austin Energy personnel access to current and proposed electric facilities. Specifically, no access routes, turning dimensions, or minimum 12-foot width truck access paths are shown to the proposed transformer pads and pull boxes on Sheets 21 and 9.

The Additional Review Acknowledgement table is not completed on the cover sheet. Only a 'Reviewed By' section with signature lines for City departments is shown. The required table documenting all applicable external reviews and approvals (such as Austin Energy, TxDOT, water districts, easement acquisition, county approval, etc.) is missing.
